name: ModelVariant823_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant823_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (while the active slot's model point flashes behind a ring of glow, up to 36 beams leave it one per frame, swinging sideways as they cross towards the opposing slot and dragging a fading ribbon; a beam that passes the far line stops, fades its head and bursts into sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the beams and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the first beam passes the far line, then 4 on every frame until 1 once after the end time when the last beam has passed, 2 once the last beam has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-840 and 937 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
